convention: Binary full tree as nested two-element arrays; leaves are integers. Address string 0=left, 1=right; empty string=input root. All equality checks exact, no tolerances.
null: Empty and absent selections must return exactly the empty set; they are outside the nonempty-terminal constructor target.
true_twins: Every corruption is paired with its unchanged base support, which must satisfy ambient, terminal, connected, and least checks.
malformed_proof: A separate Lean file asserting a true frozen equality with an ill-typed proof must fail; this failure is a harness diagnostic, not a semantic counterexample.
semantic_false: A separate Lean by-decide assertion that a selected terminal is absent, and one asserting the extra-root support equals the extractor, must fail.
stop_condition: Any frozen expected support, terminal set, corruption signature, or source comparison mismatch stops expansion pending recorded diagnosis. A finite no-fire never certifies a universal theorem.
pilot: Run only frozen cases and corruption twins first. Then scale arbitrary tree shape enumeration by leaf bound with binary labels and all subsets of {0,1}, plus absent 2 and duplicate selected labels. Record per-bound exact case counts, wall times, and source hashes before increasing bound.
